holy_circle_adapter.provenance: EffectSourceType SOURCE_DEVELOPED_TRUST=6, sourceTypeParam910 and nonzero normal originID are captured only by an approved Valaineral cast. Generic effect copy/persistence is reused without a schema migration or tier/subPower repurposing.
holy_circle_adapter.lifetime: The snapshot lasts for the ordinary effect duration after caster dismissal or feature disable; no per-hit live caster lookup is required.
holy_circle_adapter.coverage: Missing native melee/ranged/counter and magical additional/spike calculations; Lua physical/ranged/magical mob moves; standard physical/ranged/magical/hybrid WS; direct Shield Bash/Intervene; Atonement and Spirits Within.
holy_circle_adapter.no_double_application: Existing spell, BLU and breath ecosystem consumers remain single. Hybrid magical damage inherits the adjusted physical component and receives no second Circle term.
holy_circle_adapter.limits: Existing model's floored NM halves and multiplier cap are preserved. No blanket hook changes fixed HP/percentage mechanics. Exact retail numerical parity, party-wide JP interpretation and hybrid rounding are not established.
